turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided it, and on what basis?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Now the basis.
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen and read it yourself.

I'm writing those times down. Students draft somewhere else and paste it in, Hale, so that shows where the words landed, not who wrote them. And you still haven't said whether anyone heard Owen before that zero went in.
If he drafted it somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you. Until then, this is the only history there is.
Fine, Hale. Whatever comes of this, it stays off his record and it stays quiet, nowhere near his class. And I still want an answer: was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. Here is the whole play on my screen. Search every edition you like; the line is not in Hamlet.

Turn the screen, I'm searching it myself. A seventeen-year-old who paraphrases and puts it in quotation marks has made a citation error, Hale, not proved anything else. Was Owen heard first, yes or no?
It is not a misremembered line. There is no line in the play close to it. Search the word exile yourself.
I'm writing down that the word isn't there. What exactly are you proposing, Hale?
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line. Here are both, side by side.
A forty-minute timed piece and a take-home essay are never going to look alike, Hale, and you know that. I've seen enough. Put on the table what happens next.

Under procedure 4.4 this is a first concern. A supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I will put that in writing tonight.

That's 4.4, and to put this behind him, Owen will do the rewrite. Tonight's email says private, supervised, its mark replaces the zero, nothing on his record, and it includes what you said about entering the zero before calling me. Okay, Hale.
Will he do it?
He'll do it. I want the date and the room in that email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

In today's meeting you agreed that Owen will complete a private, supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, that its mark will replace the zero, and that nothing will be placed on his record. I still require the date and room for the rewrite, and written acknowledgment that the zero was entered before anyone contacted me. You said you would put this in writing tonight, and I expect it tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. She still wants written confirmation with the date, the room and your admission about entering the zero early. That is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and you got there before her time ran out.
What moved her: The version history, with its exact times on the night before the essay was due, moved her. It was specific, dated and checkable, and when she argued he could have drafted somewhere else, you answered with something she could check: bring that file and its dates.
What cost ground: Nothing. Opening with ownership of the procedure breach and then going straight to documents gave her nothing to grab.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your version history put the whole essay between 11:31 PM and 11:58 PM on a late October night, which is why she went short and hard toward procedure right then. The laptop proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked twice whether Owen was heard before the zero went in, answer her straight, because you never did, and it was the one question she kept open.
